observation: modernc.org/sqlite is a CGo-free database/sql driver and v1.57.0 documents _busy_timeout _foreign_keys _journal_mode and _txlock settings
decision: Pin modernc.org/sqlite v1.57.0 and verify effective settings

observation: WAL allows readers with a writer but only one writer at a time
decision: Keep transactions short and prove multi-process contention

observation: WAL requires processes on the same host and does not work over a network filesystem
decision: Declare one machine/filesystem authority per control store

observation: Long-running readers can prevent checkpoint completion past their end marks
decision: Forbid long-lived application reads and add a checkpoint-pressure diagnostic test

observation: A busy handler sleeps up to an accumulated bound before SQLITE_BUSY is returned
decision: Use 5000 ms busy timeout and return typed contention after the bound

observation: BEGIN IMMEDIATE starts the write transaction immediately and can fail with SQLITE_BUSY
decision: Acquire writer authority at transaction start instead of relying on deferred upgrade

observation: go version is go1.26.4 linux/amd64; modernc.org/sqlite v1.57.0 resolves and declares Go 1.25
decision: The proving environment can pin and build the selected driver
